content.json:
## Webhook Inspector operations
Capture route traffic, latency and errors, retention cleanup runs, and failures that need attention. Request counts use `itemCount`, so they are correct despite sampling. Capture spans are redacted to `/h/{token}` before export.

content.title: Captured requests by status (200 stored, 404 unknown token, 413 too large, 429 rate limit or quota)
content.query:
requests
| where name has '/h/{token}'
| summarize requests = sum(itemCount) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain}), resultCode
| render timechart

content.title: Capture route latency (ms)
content.query:
requests
| where name has '/h/{token}' and resultCode == '200'
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart

content.title: Server errors (5xx) by route
content.query:
requests
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| summarize errors = sum(itemCount) by name
| order by errors desc
content.noDataMessage: No server errors in this period.

content.title: Retention cleanup runs (hourly at :17), from the job's container logs
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerJobName_s == 'caj-webhook-inspector-cleanup'
| where Log_s has 'Retention cleanup deleted'
| extend deleted = toint(extract(@'deleted (\d+) requests', 1, Log_s))
| project TimeGenerated, deleted
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.noDataMessage: No cleanup runs in this period. The job runs every hour at :17.

content.title: Needs attention: failed captures, sign-ins and live notifications
content.query:
traces
| where message startswith 'Capture failed' or message startswith 'GitHub sign-in failed' or message startswith 'Live notification failed'
| summarize count() by message = substring(message, 0, 120), bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp desc
content.noDataMessage: Nothing needs attention in this period.
